text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa!! O winds of Tohoku, O dirt 
tracks!! Please give Digitan strength-!!

As if her prayers had been answered, Agnes 
Digital staged a furious charge and 
brilliantly claimed the crown of victory.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Digital-san! Your Winning Live 
is amazing too, by golly!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nwoh! Thank you for your kind words!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the passionate support from my 
oshi, Digi-tan has entered her final form 
with a power level over 530,000! I was 
able to run in total bliss, in pure 
heaven!!

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Them Central girls really are somethin' 
else~!! I ain't never seen runnin' that 
fast before...!

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Was her name Agnes Digital? I've gone and 
become a huge fan~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Um, hey...! Digital-san, 
would you mind shaking my hand!?

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
No fair~! Me too, me too! Can I get a 
handshake, and an autograph too!?

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
"That race earlier was so cool! You went 
whoosh and zoomed past... I wanna run like 
that too!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you sure are popular, Digital-san~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawawa! Has Digitan's unexpected 
popularity phase finally arrived!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-Trainer-san, what should I do!? 
Those pure, innocent umamusume are looking 
up to me, Degitan, with utter 
adoration...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Being cheered on with such pure eyes is 
almost humbling... or rather, I feel like 
I should be the one cheering for you!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, what should I do now...!! Digitan's 
circuits are on the verge of shorting out—
choice_data_list:
"Meeting your fave's expectations is what 
an otaku does," right?

"Meeting your fave's expectations is what 
an otaku does," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haah--!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's right! My fave comes before all 
else—if she wishes for it, I'll shake 
hands and sign autographs with everything 
I've got...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One's own confusion and embarrassment are 
trivialities!!

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Digital-san, thanks for the handshake~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The honor is mine!! I'm never washing this 
hand again!!

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're a funny one~. You gotta wash 
your hands properly before eating, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: H-Haaah...♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Heaven was... in Morioka all 
along, wasn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to see you're having fun, 
Digital-san~. Please feel free to visit 
Morioka again♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With pleasure!!!

And so, Agnes Digital's regional tour came 
to a close as a roaring success.
